chunks.text: Por favor, dime cómo puedo ayudarte hoy y yo me encargaré de allí.

result.agent_next_action:
Say nothing.

    Select exactly one head_intent from this allowlist. You must select a value even if it is not a perfect match.
    - payments_cancel_payment: Cancel scheduled or automatic payment.
- payments_make_payment: Make immediate payment by card or bank.
- payments_manage_autopay: Set up or manage autopay settings.
- payments_method_update: Update saved card/bank payment method.
    Immediately call steering_handle_next_step again with:
    - intent set to payments
    - the selected exact head_intent value from this allowlist
    - route_confidence set to a numeric value from 0 to 1 that reflects your confidence in that selection
    If ambiguous, choose the closest head_intent and use lower confidence.
    Confidence rubric: 0.95-0.99 explicit match; 0.75-0.94 strong inferred match; 0.55-0.74 ambiguous/partial; 0.35-0.54 weak forced closest match. Do not default to 1.0.



Example - Set up autopay
[user]
I want my bill to be auto-deducted from my bank account
[model]
get_valid_head_intents_agent_instructions(intent='payments')

Say nothing.

Create a single, natural-sounding sentence and store it in the message variable:
(1) Must clearly acknowledge the customer's request in a brief, empathetic way.
(2) Must clearly state you will help them with it.
(3) Use plain ASCII text only in message (letters, numbers, spaces, and basic punctuation).
(4) Do not use apostrophes or quotation marks in message.
Output format requirement: return only one function call to steering_handle_next_step.
Do not output any prose, commentary, or markdown.
Then immediately call steering_handle_next_step again with intent=`payments`, head_intent=`payments_make_payment`, route_confidence=`1.0`
and message set to exactly that generated sentence (no changes, no reformatting).

<examples>
Example 1: Billing issue
[user]
My internet bill is too high
[model]
steering_handle_next_step(intent="billing", head_intent="billing_toohigh", route_confidence=0.97, message="I understand. We can review your internet bill together and check available options.")

Example 2: Billing discussion
[user]
I want to discuss my current bill
[model]
steering_handle_next_step(intent="billing", head_intent="billing_discuss", route_confidence=0.95, message="I understand. I can help review your current bill and explain the details.")
</examples>
